conventions: Every id is a UUID (primary and foreign keys alike): it cannot be mistaken for an amount or a count, and an id from one table can never match a row of another by accident. Human-readable references (such as KYC-2026-004512) are separate fields.

Every case table has a reference staff quote on the phone, in letters and audits: PREFIX-YEAR-NUMBER, e.g. KYC-2026-004512. Prefixes: CUS customers, KYC kyc_cases, ALR alerts, INV investigations, SAR sar_reports, HIT screening_hits, DSP dispute_requests, CBK chargebacks, SEP sepa_disputes, APP loan_applications, LON loans, COL collection_cases, LIM limit_requests, CMP complaints, CHG customer_change_requests, CLO closures, HLD holds, AUT authority_requests, EVT business_events, INS insolvency_proceedings, DEC deceased_cases, QA qa_reviews, RFI information_requests.
Amounts are in euros unless a currency field says otherwise: only accounts, transactions, fees, card payments abroad (original currency) and transfers carry one.

Status history lives in one status_changes table: record_id is the id of the changed row in any case table (UUIDs never collide across tables), record_type names the table. The few dates a banker expects to read on the record itself (escalated_at, filed_at...) stay as fields.
Countries are ISO 3166 two-letter codes (FR, DE), currencies ISO 4217 codes (EUR), operators are identified by their email in *_by fields.

accounts.purpose: Accounts owned by a customer (retail or business). type = CURRENT / SAVINGS / BUSINESS; plan = STANDARD / PREMIUM / METAL / BUSINESS_PRO decides which fees apply. Status ACTIVE / FROZEN / DORMANT / CLOSED.

transactions.purpose: Master table: one row per movement on an account, as on a bank statement. rail = CARD / TRANSFER / DIRECT_DEBIT / WERO / WALLET / FEE / INTERNAL tells which detail table holds the rest (WERO: the transfer, plus its wero_payments row). INTERNAL covers interest, refunds paid out and provisional credits. counterparty_id is empty for FEE and INTERNAL: the bank itself. status = PENDING / HELD / BOOKED / REVERSED / REJECTED (HELD: stopped by screening or fraud checks, waiting for a decision). category = GROCERIES / TRANSPORT / RESTAURANTS / SHOPPING / BILLS / SALARY / CASH / TRANSFERS / REFUNDS / FEES / LOANS / OTHER (LOANS: loan payouts and repayments) (REFUNDS: refunds, provisional credits, returns and compensation after a dispute or a complaint); status_reason says why it is HELD, REJECTED or REVERSED.

card_transactions.purpose: Card payments and withdrawals: one per card transaction. Status AUTHORIZED / CLEARED / REVERSED. entry_mode = CHIP / CONTACTLESS / ONLINE / MOBILE_WALLET. Status follows the card payment: AUTHORIZED (amount set aside) / DECLINED (decline_reason = INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS / WRONG_PIN / SUSPECTED_FRAUD / CARD_BLOCKED / LIMIT_EXCEEDED / EXPIRED_CARD) / CLEARED (final amount from the merchant, booked) / SETTLED (money moved between banks through the network, settled_at) / REVERSED (cancelled before clearing) / EXPIRED (never cleared, released after about 7 days). The transaction follows: AUTHORIZED = PENDING, CLEARED or SETTLED = BOOKED, REVERSED or EXPIRED = REVERSED, DECLINED = REJECTED. Chargebacks apply to settled payments. wallet_type = APPLE_PAY / GOOGLE_PAY / SAMSUNG_PAY. type = PURCHASE / ATM_WITHDRAWAL.

direct_debits.purpose: Direct debits taken by a creditor under a mandate. sequence = FIRST / RECURRING / ONE_OFF. status = SCHEDULED / COLLECTED / REJECTED / RETURNED / REFUNDED.

wero_payments.purpose: A Wero payment of one of our customers, to or from one of its Wero contacts (known by phone number or email): direction = SENT / RECEIVED, flow = P2P / ECOMMERCE / REQUEST_TO_PAY, status = REQUESTED / PAID / DECLINED / EXPIRED. A paid one moves money by SEPA Instant and has its transaction (rail WERO); a declined or expired request to pay has none. account_id is our customer's account.

wallet_transfers.purpose: Wallet to wallet between two customers of the bank. Always 2 transactions: a debit on the sender's account and a credit on the receiver's, sharing the transfer_reference. Each side's counterparty is a WALLET_PEER counterparty; peer_account_id gives the other customer's account.

actions: Waive fee (goodwill gesture, approval above a threshold)
fees.purpose: Fees the bank charges its customers. type = MONTHLY_PLAN / CARD_ANNUAL / CARD_REPLACEMENT / FOREIGN_CARD_PAYMENT / FOREIGN_ATM_WITHDRAWAL / INSTANT_TRANSFER / REJECTED_PAYMENT / OVERDRAFT / PAPER_STATEMENT. status = CHARGED / WAIVED / REFUNDED. The fee itself is a transaction (rail FEE, no counterparty); triggered_by_transaction_id is the payment that caused it, when there is one. refund_transaction_id: the INTERNAL transaction that paid a refunded fee back.

counterparties.purpose: Master table: the other side of every transaction, so that transactions need one column for it whatever the payment method. counterparty_type says which detail table holds the rest: CARD_MERCHANT (card_merchants), SCT_EMITTER (sct_emitters), SCT_BENEFICIARY (sct_beneficiaries), SDD_CREDITOR (sdd_creditors), WERO_CONTACT (wero_contacts), WALLET_PEER (another customer of the bank, through wallet_transfers). One counterparty has exactly one type: a company paying by card and crediting by transfer is two counterparties. Name, country, risk and the blocked flag live here once per counterparty.

card_merchants.purpose: Where customers pay by card: one row per shop, shared by every cardholder (fraud teams look at a merchant across all customers). MCC, category and acquirer; chargebacks reach it through the card payment.

sct_emitters.purpose: Who sends money to one of our customers by SEPA credit transfer (SCT, Instant included): one row per customer and sending account, with its own SCT_EMITTER counterparty. The employer paying ten of our customers is ten emitters.

sct_beneficiaries.purpose: Who one of our customers sends money to by SEPA credit transfer: one row per customer and payee, with its own SCT_BENEFICIARY counterparty, created on the first payment. is_saved marks the customer's saved payee list; one-off payments to a new IBAN (typical of push payment scams) have is_saved false. A payee added from a new device right before a large transfer is the takeover pattern.

sdd_creditors.purpose: A company that takes money by SEPA direct debit (SDD) under a mandate: utility, telecom, insurer, tax and social security. Shared by every customer: one SEPA creditor identifier; the per-customer link is the mandate.

wero_contacts.purpose: A Wero contact of one of our customers, known by phone number or email, with its own WERO_CONTACT counterparty.

mandates.purpose: Relationship: an account authorised this creditor to take money (CORE or B2B).

individuals.purpose: People. A person is a retail customer, a member of one or more businesses, or both. Holds everything about the person (identity, address, PEP and sanctions flags), moved out of today's customers table. Also the declared profile collected at onboarding: occupation, employment_status (EMPLOYED / SELF_EMPLOYED / RETIRED / STUDENT / UNEMPLOYED), income_band, source_of_funds (SALARY / BUSINESS_INCOME / PENSION / SAVINGS / INHERITANCE / INVESTMENTS / OTHER), source_of_wealth, tax residence and tax id (CRS / FATCA).

businesses.purpose: Companies. accepts_card_payments is checked when the bank processes the company's card sales (terminal or online checkout); the fields after it are only filled then: what it sells, expected volumes, delivery delay (the risk of paying back buyers if it fails), chargeback ratio (card networks penalise above about 1%) and the share of sales held back as a reserve. Not to be confused with merchants: shops where our customers pay. Registered address, VAT number and source_of_funds (REVENUE / SHAREHOLDER_FUNDS / LOAN / INVESTMENT / GRANT) are filled for every company.

business_members.purpose: Join table: the company's structure, as in the company register. The member is a person (individual_id) or another company (owner_business_id), so KYB can follow a holding chain up to the real owners. role = OWNER / SHAREHOLDER / DIRECTOR / MANAGER. ownership_pct finds the beneficial owners (25% and more). source = COMPANY_REGISTER / UBO_REGISTER / CLIENT_DECLARATION.

customer_members.purpose: Join table: every person who can act on a customer relationship, and how. role = HOLDER / JOINT_HOLDER / LEGAL_GUARDIAN / ATTORNEY / AUTHORISED_USER / SIGNATORY. A joint account is one customer with two HOLDER rows; a minor's account has a HOLDER (the minor) and a LEGAL_GUARDIAN. proof_document_id: the power of attorney or guardianship order behind an ATTORNEY or LEGAL_GUARDIAN row.

actions: Request information (neutral wording, linked to the investigation)
Request enhanced due diligence (opens a KYC case)
investigations.purpose: Level 2: what needs a closer look on a customer. type = AML / FRAUD / IDENTITY_FRAUD / SANCTIONS / ACCOUNT_TAKEOVER. origin = ALERTS (escalated by level 1) / KYC_ESCALATION (something looked wrong at onboarding or a review: origin_kyc_case_id) / SCREENING_HIT / AUTHORITY_REQUEST (police or financial intelligence unit) / INTERNAL_REFERRAL / ADVERSE_MEDIA / CUSTOMER_REPORT (the customer reported payments they did not make). Groups the alerts and screening hits behind it. Information requested from the client links to the investigation; its wording never reveals it (tipping off is an offence). Ends in a SAR, a documented decision not to file, or an exit. decision = SAR_FILED / NO_SAR / EXIT_RELATIONSHIP, signed off by the MLRO. priority = LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH / URGENT; amount_involved in euros. origin DISPUTE: a customer's unauthorised claim the bank doubts; decision FIRST_PARTY_FRAUD when the customer made the payment themselves.

rules.purpose: The monitoring rules that raise alerts, for AML, fraud and account takeover alike. Powers the "alerts per rule" and false-positive rate dashboards. default_severity = LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH / CRITICAL; code such as AML-STR-03.

alert_transactions.purpose: Join table: the transactions behind each alert (the trigger and the context), for every alert category. role = TRIGGER / CONTEXT.

watchlist_entries.purpose: Entries from sanctions and PEP lists (OFAC, EU, UN, UK HMT, PEP database). entity_type = PERSON / ENTITY / VESSEL / AIRCRAFT; source_entry_id is the list's own id.

screening_hits.purpose: A possible match between a list entry and exactly one of: a person, a company, or a counterparty. transaction_id is set when screening held a payment to or from that counterparty. status = OPEN / TRUE_MATCH / FALSE_POSITIVE. trigger = ONBOARDING / DAILY_RESCREENING / PAYMENT / LIST_UPDATE; screened_name is a snapshot of the name screened. hit_type = SANCTIONS / PEP (a sanctions hit blocks, a PEP hit leads to enhanced due diligence); entity_type = PERSON / ENTITY / VESSEL / AIRCRAFT, what the list entry is.

devices.purpose: Phones and browsers a customer logs in from.

login_events.purpose: Login history: new device plus new country plus password reset is the takeover pattern. event_type = LOGIN / PASSWORD_RESET / MFA_RESET / LOGOUT; auth_method = PASSWORD / BIOMETRIC / SMS_OTP / APP_PUSH; failure_reason = WRONG_PASSWORD / OTP_FAILED / ACCOUNT_LOCKED / DEVICE_BLOCKED.

information_requests.purpose: Every question the bank asks, whatever the desk: missing KYC documents, source of funds, chargeback details, consent to return funds, proof of income, guarantor documents, collections. context = KYC_CASE / INVESTIGATION / CHANGE_REQUEST / DISPUTE_REQUEST / CHARGEBACK / SEPA_DISPUTE / LOAN_APPLICATION / COMPLAINT / COLLECTION_CASE / GUARANTEE says which case it serves, and that case's link is set (one of kyc_case_id, investigation_id, change_request_id, chargeback_id, sepa_dispute_id, loan_application_id, complaint_id, collection_case_id, guarantee_id) and to the person asked (addressed_to_id: any individual, a customer member or a guarantor). status = DRAFT / SENT / ANSWERED / OVERDUE / CANCELLED. Powers a "waiting on the client" inbox and an "overdue requests" dashboard. A request serving an investigation links to it internally; the questions the client reads never mention it (tipping off is an offence).

customer_change_requests.purpose: Changes to a person's data (address, phone, email, name), asked from a customer space. A phone change right before a large transfer is a takeover red flag. verification_method = OTP_OLD_PHONE / ID_AND_SELFIE / CALLBACK / NONE.

complaints.purpose: Complaints with their legal deadline, linked to what they are about (a transaction, a fee, a chargeback, a dispute request or a SEPA dispute). outcome = UPHELD / PARTIALLY_UPHELD / REJECTED; compensation is paid as an INTERNAL transaction; root_cause feeds the regulator-facing dashboard. A customer unhappy with the answer can escalate: escalated_to = BANKING_MEDIATOR (free, gives an opinion within 90 days) / ACPR (the supervisor, which collects complaints but does not settle them) / COURT; escalation_outcome = FOR_CUSTOMER / FOR_BANK / SPLIT.

closures.purpose: Closing one account (account_id set) or the whole relationship (account_id empty). initiated_by = CUSTOMER / BANK. reason = CUSTOMER_REQUEST / RISK_EXIT / DECEASED / INSOLVENCY / DORMANCY / FRAUD, linked to what decided it. A retail customer gets 2 months' notice (notice_end_date), except for fraud or financial crime. The remaining balance goes to payout_beneficiary_id. payout_transaction_id: the transfer that sent the remaining balance.

holds.purpose: Money on an account that cannot be spent: reason = AUTHORITY_REQUEST / FRAUD / INVESTIGATION / SANCTIONS / DISPUTE / INSOLVENCY, linked to its source (authority request, alert, investigation, screening hit, chargeback or SEPA dispute, insolvency). Available balance = balance minus active holds. A single payment stopped before execution is a transaction with status HELD instead. A hold names its source and, when there is one, the case it serves (a fraud alert and the recall it is about); a sanctions hold is the asset freeze of a confirmed sanctions match.

authority_requests.purpose: Everything an authority serves on the bank about a debtor, person (individual_id) or company (business_id). type = SEIZURE (saisie-attribution) / PRECAUTIONARY_FREEZE (saisie conservatoire) / TAX_GARNISHMENT (SATD) / INFORMATION_REQUEST. requester_type = BAILIFF / TAX_AUTHORITY / SOCIAL_SECURITY / COURT / POLICE / FIU. protected_amount (minimum balance left untouched) applies to individuals only. Money is blocked through holds; an information request from police or the FIU can open an investigation. channel = POST / EMAIL / BAILIFF_PORTAL / IN_PERSON.

business_events.purpose: Changes to a company, usually detected from the company register (BODACC / RNE, Companies House). type = OWNERSHIP_CHANGE / DIRECTOR_CHANGE / ADDRESS_CHANGE / LEGAL_FORM_CHANGE / CAPITAL_CHANGE / INSOLVENCY_OPENED / DISSOLUTION. source = COMPANY_REGISTER / CLIENT / ADVERSE_MEDIA. Can open a KYB event review (kyc_case_id).

insolvency_proceedings.purpose: Collective proceedings on a client. type = SAFEGUARD / RECEIVERSHIP / LIQUIDATION (companies) / PERSONAL_DEBT_RESTRUCTURING (retail over-indebtedness). The court-appointed practitioner (administrator or liquidator) takes control of the accounts and pays the creditors; the bank files its own claim before claims_deadline if it is owed money, hands over the balance, then closes the accounts.

deceased_cases.purpose: A customer member has died: freeze, verify, then pay the estate. Joint accounts carry on with the survivor.

qa_reviews.purpose: A reviewer re-checks an operator's decision on one record (a KYC case, an alert, an investigation, a chargeback or a complaint). sample_reason = RANDOM / HIGH_RISK / NEW_OPERATOR.

sepa_disputes.purpose: SEPA R-transactions that need ops work. scheme = SDD_CORE / SDD_B2B / SCT / SCT_INST (Wero included). type = REFUND (SDD Core: 8 weeks no questions asked, or up to 13 months if unauthorised; SDD B2B: unauthorised only) / RETURN (we send a debit back: insufficient funds, closed account) / RECALL (duplicate, technical, fraud) / REQUEST_FOR_RECALL (customer error: wrong IBAN, wrong amount). side = WE_ASKED / WE_ARE_ASKED. reason_code is the ISO code (MD06, MD01, AM04, DUPL, FRAD, AC03...). status = OPEN / WAITING_OTHER_BANK / WAITING_CUSTOMER / ACCEPTED / REFUSED / PARTIAL. An incoming recall for customer error needs our customer's consent (asked through an information request); an incoming fraud recall is a money-mule signal and raises an alert. return_transaction_id is the movement that sent the money back. Card disputes stay in chargebacks (multi-round network lifecycle). reason = CUSTOMER_REQUEST / UNAUTHORISED / INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS / ACCOUNT_CLOSED / DUPLICATE / TECHNICAL / FRAUD / WRONG_IBAN / WRONG_AMOUNT; reason_code is the matching ISO code. The payment's detail row is linked: direct_debit_id, incoming_transfer_id (another bank asks money back from our customer) or outgoing_transfer_id (we ask money back).

loan_applications.purpose: Credit applications from a customer (a person, a joint customer or a business). product = PERSONAL_LOAN / CAR_LOAN / BNPL / BUSINESS_TERM_LOAN (overdraft is an account limit, see limit_requests). Holds the affordability (declared income and expenses), the external score and the credit register check (in France, consulting the Banque de France FICP file is mandatory before consumer credit), and the offer (amount, rate, term), which can differ from the request. offered_apr: the APR (TAEG), mandatory on every consumer credit offer; channel = APP / WEB / BRANCH / BROKER.

loans.purpose: Granted loans. status = CURRENT / LATE / DEFAULT / RESTRUCTURED / REPAID. withdrawal_deadline: EU consumer credit gives 14 days to withdraw after signing. The payout is a transaction (disbursement_transaction_id). contract_number is the loan's reference (LON-…). customer_id is the borrower (the account's customer). Consumer credit is paid out no earlier than 7 days after signing, and the borrower can withdraw within 14 days.

repayments.purpose: The repayment schedule. Each payment taken is a transaction on the account (transaction_id). status = SCHEDULED / PAID / PARTIAL / MISSED.

guarantees.purpose: Personal guarantees and collateral behind a loan. type = PERSONAL_GUARANTEE / PROPERTY / CASH_DEPOSIT / VEHICLE / STATE_GUARANTEE (e.g. PGE in France). The guarantor is a person or a company, often not a member of the borrowing customer (a director guaranteeing their company's loan).

collection_cases.purpose: Recovering missed payments on a loan, or an overdraft in arrears (account_id). stage = EARLY / LATE / LEGAL / WRITTEN_OFF. outcome = PAID / PAYMENT_PLAN / RESTRUCTURED / WRITTEN_OFF. Paused by personal debt restructuring (insolvency_proceeding_id). One of the largest ops teams in a real bank.

limit_requests.purpose: Requests to change a limit. type = CARD_PAYMENT / CARD_WITHDRAWAL / TRANSFER / OVERDRAFT (only OVERDRAFT is credit). requested_by_id is the member who asked; temporary_until for a temporary raise.

investigation_transactions.purpose: Join table: the transactions an analyst attaches to an investigation (from its alerts or found while investigating), and which ones go into the SAR (included_in_sar). Needed because investigations from KYC, authorities, press or referrals have no alerts.

status_changes.purpose: The history of every case: one row per status change (or any tracked field), whatever the table. record_type names the table, record_id is the changed row (UUIDs never collide across tables, so no join table is needed). Gives every record page a timeline tab.

incoming_transfers.purpose: SEPA credit transfers received by a customer, from an SCT emitter. scheme = SEPA / SEPA_INSTANT; remittance_info is the sender's message ("Salaire octobre", "Facture 4512").

outgoing_transfers.purpose: SEPA credit transfers sent by a customer to one of its SCT beneficiaries. initiated_via = BANKING_APP / API (Wero payments have their own table); payee_check is the EU Verification of Payee result; transfers above the threshold wait for validation (four-eyes); sca_method is how the customer approved it (Strong Customer Authentication). callback_at and callback_result = CONFIRMED / DENIED / NOT_REACHED record the call back to the customer before a decision.

dispute_transactions.purpose: Join table: every money movement of a dispute, with its role. role = DISPUTED (the payment the customer contests, or the one another bank asks back) / PROVISIONAL_CREDIT / CREDIT_REVERSAL (the merchant won) / REFUND (money given back to our customer) / RETURN (money sent back to the other bank) / COMPENSATION (goodwill paid after a complaint). Each row links every case it belongs to: the dispute request, and the chargeback or SEPA dispute it was routed to.

einvoicing_registrations.purpose: One business customer in the national e-invoicing directory (annuaire). routing_address is where other platforms send its invoices. receiving_platform = OUR_PLATFORM / OTHER_PLATFORM (the customer chose another approved platform: we only bank it). status = PENDING (directory entry being created) / ACTIVE / LEFT. company_size = MICRO / SME / MID_SIZE / LARGE sets sending_mandatory_from (SMEs: 2027-09-01); sends_einvoices with voluntary_since for the ones that started early. vat_regime = MONTHLY / QUARTERLY / SIMPLIFIED sets the e-reporting rhythm. A company on another platform shows its routing address but no dates: we registered nothing for it. other_platform names the approved platform it uses instead.

invoices.purpose: E-invoices carried by our platform: direction = ISSUED (our customer bills a client) / RECEIVED (a supplier bills our customer). status follows the life cycle the DGFiP expects: SUBMITTED (déposée) / REJECTED (rejetée: the platform found it non-compliant, it must be fixed and sent again) / ISSUED (émise) / RECEIVED (reçue) / APPROVED (approuvée) / DISPUTED (en litige) / REFUSED (refusée: the buyer will not process it) / PAYMENT_SENT (paiement transmis) / CASHED (encaissée, mandatory for services when VAT is due on payment). nature = GOODS / SERVICES / MIXED; vat_on_debits is the option to pay VAT on services when invoiced. format = FACTUR_X (PDF with the data inside) / UBL / CII. On a received invoice, iban_check compares payee_iban with the IBAN we know for that supplier: KNOWN / NEW_SUPPLIER / CHANGED (a changed IBAN raises a fraud alert before anything is paid). The file field shows the invoice as a PDF. invoice_number follows one continuous sequence per seller (French tax code); delivery_date is when the goods were delivered or the service done.

invoice_payments.purpose: Which payment settles which invoice, from the account's statement. match_status = AUTO_MATCHED (reference and amount agree) / SUGGESTED (close but not certain: a typo in the reference, a partial payment; an operator or the customer confirms) / CONFIRMED / DISMISSED. A confirmed match on an issued invoice makes it CASHED.

ereporting_submissions.purpose: What the platform reports to the tax office besides the invoices themselves. flow = TRANSACTIONS (sales to consumers and abroad, which have no e-invoice) / PAYMENTS (cash received on services sold to consumers or abroad; domestic B2B e-invoices report their cash through the CASHED status). Monthly VAT regime: transactions every 10 days (1-10, 11-20, 21-end), due 10 days after the period; payments monthly, due by the 10th of the next month. status = TO_SUBMIT / SUBMITTED / ACCEPTED / REJECTED; a corrected submission replaces_id the rejected one. SMEs report from 2027-09-01; the ones here report voluntarily, having started early.
